title: 1987 AMC 8 Problem 16
statement: Joyce made \(12\) of her first \(30\) shots in the first three games of the basketball season, so her seasonal shooting average was \(40\%.\) In her next game, she took \(10\) shots and raised her seasonal shooting average to \(50\%.\) How many of these \(10\) shots did she make?

solutions.text:
After the fourth game she has taken \(40\) shots. A \(50\%\) average means she made \(\tfrac12 \times 40 = 20\) shots in total.

She had already made \(12,\) so she made \(20 - 12 = 8\) of the last \(10.\)

Thus, the correct answer is E .
hints: After the next game she has attempted \(30 + 10 = 40\) shots
A \(50\%\) average on \(40\) shots means \(20\) made in all; she already had \(12\)
